name: Battleship Yamato
description: "Yamato" is the first Yamato-class battleship built by the Imperial Japanese Navy in World War II. It is the largest battleship in human history. It was once known as "the world's first battleship" and "the savior of the Japanese Empire." The battleship is 263 meters long, 38.9 meters wide, has a full load displacement of 72,808 tons, and a speed of up to 27 knots. The "Yamato" has a spherical bow and has more than 20 large-caliber main and secondary guns. It has thick armor and strong protection capabilities. Even if two torpedoes or several heavy aerial bombs are hit at the same time, the battle will not be affected.
